name: GoldenNugget Mobile (soum91 fork)
subtitle: On-device iOS customization
description: FlareStore source for the soum91 GoldenNugget Mobile fork. Currently serves the verified upstream 9.7.5 IPA; a forked 9.7.6 build with the .batter picker fix is pending.

apps.name: GoldenNugget Mobile
apps.subtitle: On-device tweaks for iOS 26 and 27
apps.localizedDescription: GoldenNugget Mobile runs on-device customization and partial restore workflows for iOS 26 and 27. This 9.7.5 IPA is the official upstream release. The fork's 9.7.6 .batter file-picker fix is in source code only and is not included in this download yet. Back up the device before applying tweaks.
